inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada is right to put its own people and public order first. With Bill C-12 receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026, tighter rules for Nigerians and others send a necessary message: immigration and asylum must be governed by law, not sentiment. A country that fails to enforce its borders risks losing public trust and weakening the social order that holds communities together.
